title: Wildmark Library: 10 Fantasy Hero Sprite Packs + New Ones
short_text: 10 fantasy hero sprite packs in one download, every new Wildmark pack added free
description:
10 Wildmark fantasy hero sprite packs in one download: 18 heroes, 50 held items, 4 action sets, MZ battlers, Godot 4 and RPG Maker MZ files, $76.90 one by one. Royalty free in commercial games, no credit required. This page is $14.99. The CSAF Sprite Library ($19.99) includes this family and every other CSAF sprite pack.

Buy once, keep every Wildmark pack that joins.

How the future packs work

  • When a new Wildmark pack comes out, its files are added to this page on launch day.
  • You do not pay again. Open your itch.io library and the new files are there.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here, so follow the page to hear about it.

Latest additions

  • 2026-11-13: Wildmark Actions 01 joins, repaired, with strike, hurt and death for the 4 Wildmark 01 heroes in three directions, 456 PNG frames and sheets.
  • 2026-11-13: Wildmark 02 joins, repaired, with 4 more heroes (priest, vanguard, alchemist, forester) with idle and walk in four directions, 264 PNG frames and sheets.
  • 2026-11-12: Handheld 01 joins with 50 held weapons and tools drawn into the hands of the 4 Wildmark 01 heroes, on every idle and walk frame in all four facings. New here first: it has no page of its own yet.
  • 2026-11-07: the three pack Wildmark Collection becomes the Wildmark Library, 7 packs and 4,956 PNG frames and sheets.

What's inside (10 packs)

The hero casts: Wildmark 01 to 04 (4 packs, $22.96 one by one): Wildmark 01: The Party, 128x128 & 64x64 hero character sprites; Wildmark 02: The Second Rank, 128x128 RPG Character Sprites; Wildmark 03: The Far Kin, 128x128 & 64x64 character sprites; Wildmark 04: Dragonkin, 128x128 & 64x64 character sprites.

Held weapons and tools for the Wildmark 01 heroes: Handheld 01 (1 pack, $8.99 one by one): Handheld 01: 50 held weapons and tools for the Wildmark party [128x128 & 64x64] (new here first, no page of its own yet).

Extra action sets for the heroes: Wildmark Actions 01 to 04 (4 packs, $37.96 one by one): Wildmark Actions 01: 204 Strike, Hurt and Death Frames; Wildmark Actions 02: Four Facings, strike, hurt, death & cast, 128x128 & 64x64 sprites; Wildmark Actions 03: Everyday Verbs, pick up, interact, knockdown & get up, 128x128 & 64x64 sprites; Wildmark Actions 04: Roll and Guard, dodge roll & block sprites, 4 directions, 128x128 & 64x64.

Wildmark Battlers: the heroes as RPG Maker MZ side-view actors (1 pack, $6.99 one by one): Wildmark Battlers: Side-View Sprites for RPG Maker MZ.

What a pack contains

Every pack sits in its own folder exactly as its own page delivers it (Handheld 01: the package its own page will carry): PNG frames and sheets at 64x64 and 128x128, a frames.json map, Godot 4 SpriteFrames, its own Readme and its own licence. Wildmark 01, Wildmark 02, Wildmark 03 and Wildmark 04 are hero casts (18 heroes) with idle and walk in four directions. Handheld 01 draws 50 held weapons and tools into the hands of the 4 Wildmark 01 heroes as overlay sheets laid out cell for cell like theirs, and every item also ships alone in its own cell. Wildmark Actions 01 adds death, hurt and strike; Wildmark Actions 02 adds strike, hurt, death and cast; Wildmark Actions 03 adds pick up, interact, knockdown and get up; Wildmark Actions 04 adds dodge roll and guard. All 4 action sets animate the Wildmark 01 party, and Wildmark Actions 02 also animates the 4 heroes of Wildmark 02. Wildmark Battlers turns 8 heroes into RPG Maker MZ side-view actors with all 18 battle motions. 5 packs carry RPG Maker MZ sheets; every pack works in any engine that reads PNG, including Unity and GameMaker. CATALOGUE.md lists every folder and its page.

Licence

You can use the sprites in commercial and personal games, as many projects as you like, with no royalty and no credit required, and edit them freely. You can't resell or share the sprites themselves as an asset pack, or use them to train a model. Each pack's own LICENSE.txt governs its folder.

The art in all 10 packs is generated with an AI pixel art model (PixelLab, on a paid plan that grants commercial use), then palette locked and checked by our own tooling. The tooling was written with AI assistance.

Try before you buy

Free heroes from the same family: Wildmark Sampler: 4 Free Fantasy Hero Sprites [128 & 64 px].

Questions or a hero you want next: post a comment below, or on the Request Desk. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Shipping on Steam? Steam's Content Survey asks you to describe content made with the help of AI tools that ships in your game, and the note above says how these sprites were made. A line you can adapt: "Some sprites in this game come from a third party asset library and were generated with an AI pixel art model."

Made something with this? Post it below and we will add it to our Made With collection.

$14.99. Buyers keep every Wildmark pack that joins.

devlog.title: Wildmark Library: Wildmark 02 and Actions 01 added, repaired, 10 packs now
devlog.html:
Two Wildmark packs held back from this page since 6 November are in it now, each the day its repair shipped. If you own this page they are already in your download, free. Open your itch.io library or let the itch app update it.

  • Wildmark 02: The Second Rank adds 4 heroes (priest, vanguard, alchemist, forester) with idle and walk in four directions, 264 PNG files in heroes/wildmark-02-the-second-rank/. Version 1.4.0 repairs the forester's north walk, where her axe lost its haft. Wildmark Actions 02 already animates these 4, so their actions now have their walking pack beside them.
  • Wildmark Actions 01 adds strike, hurt and death for the 4 Wildmark 01 heroes in three directions, 456 PNG files in action-sets/wildmark-actions-01/. Version 1.2.0 re-draws the rogue's side strike and the warrior's east hurt, which turned toward or away from the camera partway through.

The Library now holds 10 Wildmark packs for $14.99, worth $76.90 bought one by one. Every new Wildmark pack joins on its launch day.

The art is generated with an AI pixel art model (PixelLab, paid plan) and checked by our own tooling. Free Wildmark heroes to try first: wildmark-sampler. Questions or a hero you want next: leave a comment. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.
